programs.keyRule: Age 65+ with ownership interest in the home as principal residence: additional $60,000 school-district homestead exemption (not income-tested), school tax ceiling, optional deferral

programs.name: VA Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers
programs.agency: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VHA Caregiver Support Program)
programs.reason: PCAFC serves caregivers of living veterans with a 70%+ service-connected rating; a veteran's surviving spouse is not covered.
programs.keyRule: Veteran must have a VA service-connected disability rating (individual or combined) of 70% or higher

firstCall.program: VA Survivors Pension with Aid and Attendance
firstCall.phoneOrWhere: Bexar County Military and Veterans Services Center, (210) HELP-VET / (210) 435-7838, 1422 E. Grayson St., San Antonio (by appointment)
firstCall.why: It is the one program she clearly qualifies for today with no waitlist or spend-down, and the monthly cash (larger if she pays for care) can fund help that relieves the daughter while Medicaid/CAS is sorted out.

families.notes: Check whether the 'small widow's pension' is already a VA Survivors Pension or DIC; if it is a basic VA pension she should request the A&A increase, and if it is DIC she cannot receive both. If she pays the daughter for care under a written agreement, VA may count those payments as unreimbursed medical expenses, raising the award. VA pension income can affect SLMB/Medicaid budgeting (the A&A and medical-expense portions are generally excluded for Medicaid). Under consumer-directed services, a non-spouse relative such as the daughter can be the paid attendant for CAS/STAR+PLUS. The Medicaid spend-down must avoid gifts (5-year look-back); VA has its own 3-year look-back.
